# Glyphide

> Glyphide is a lightweight, 100% client-side web code editor and sandboxed WebAssembly execution environment for JavaScript and Python.

## Core Characteristics

- **Client-Side WebAssembly Execution**: Runs code locally using MicroPython (~436 KB) for Python and QuickJS (~492 KB) for JavaScript. Zero server interaction or cloud compilation queues.
- **Zero Telemetry & Absolute Privacy**: Code never leaves the device. No tracking, no user accounts, and no central database.
- **Sub-100ms Cold Start**: Instant engine instantiation compared to 3-10s heavy runtimes (Pyodide/JupyterLite).
- **Offline Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Works 100% offline via Service Worker caching WASM engines, fonts, and editor bundles.
- **Stateless URL Sharing**: Code state is compressed into URL parameters or hashes, enabling instant sharing without cloud storage.

## Target Use Cases

- Private code testing and algorithm execution without data leakage.
- Classroom and school environments on Chromebooks without local toolchains.
- Travel or low-connectivity programming (in-flight, transit).
- Instant, friction-free runnable code snippet sharing in developer forums.
